# Plot and compare trees from different CleanedData sources and processing steps

- mitochondrial tree (from 05_phylogeny/mitochondrial_tree.nwk)
- plastid tree (from 05_phylogeny/plastid_tree.nwk)
- species tree from wASTRAL with collapsed nodes < 60 UFBoot
- species tree from wASTRAL without collapsed nodes

## Read in trees

```{r}
library(ape)
library(dplyr)
```
```{r}
mit_tree <- read.tree("CleanedData/05_phylogeny_flanking/concat_mit.treefile") %>%
#root(outgroup = "Ixora_sp") %>%
ladderize()

plastid_tree <- read.tree("CleanedData/05_phylogeny_flanking/concat_ptd.treefile") %>%
root(outgroup = "Ixora_sp") %>%
ladderize()

nuc_tree <- read.tree("CleanedData/05_phylogeny_flanking/concat_nuc.treefile") %>%
root(outgroup = "Ixora_sp") %>%
ladderize()

```


```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(mit_tree, main="Mitochondrial Tree")
nodelabels(mit_tree$node.label, cex=0.5)
plot(plastid_tree, main="Plastid Tree")
nodelabels(plastid_tree$node.label, cex=0.5)
plot(nuc_tree, main="Nuclear Tree")
nodelabels(nuc_tree$node.label, cex=0.5)


# plot(species_tree_collapsed, main="Species Tree (Collapsed)")
# nodelabels(species_tree_collapsed$node.label, cex=0.5)
# plot(species_tree_uncollapsed, main="Species Tree (Uncollapsed)")
# nodelabels(species_tree_uncollapsed$node.label, cex=0.5)

```


```{r}
plot_linked_trees <- function(tree_left, tree_right,
															left_title = "Left tree",
															right_title = "Right tree") {
	shared_tips <- intersect(tree_left$tip.label, tree_right$tip.label)
	if (length(shared_tips) == 0) {
		stop("The trees do not have any identical tip labels.")
	}

	old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
	on.exit(par(old_par), add = TRUE)

	par(mar = c(1, 1, 3, 1), xpd = NA)
	layout(matrix(c(1, 2), nrow = 1), widths = c(1, 1))

	plot(tree_left, main = left_title, direction = "rightwards",
			 cex = 0.65, no.margin = TRUE)
	left_plot <- get("last_plot.phylo", envir = .PlotPhyloEnv)
	left_tips <- setNames(seq_along(tree_left$tip.label), tree_left$tip.label)
	left_ndc <- cbind(
		grconvertX(left_plot$xx[left_tips[shared_tips]], from = "user", to = "ndc"),
		grconvertY(left_plot$yy[left_tips[shared_tips]], from = "user", to = "ndc")
	)

	plot(tree_right, main = right_title, direction = "leftwards",
			 cex = 0.65, no.margin = TRUE)
	right_plot <- get("last_plot.phylo", envir = .PlotPhyloEnv)
	right_tips <- setNames(seq_along(tree_right$tip.label), tree_right$tip.label)
	right_ndc <- cbind(
		grconvertX(right_plot$xx[right_tips[shared_tips]], from = "user", to = "ndc"),
		grconvertY(right_plot$yy[right_tips[shared_tips]], from = "user", to = "ndc")
	)

	par(fig = c(0, 1, 0, 1), new = TRUE, mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
	plot.new()
	plot.window(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
	segments(left_ndc[, 1], left_ndc[, 2], right_ndc[, 1], right_ndc[, 2],
					 col = grDevices::adjustcolor("grey35", alpha.f = 0.45), lty = 2)
}

plot_linked_trees(
	ladderize(nuc_tree),
	ladderize(plastid_tree),
	left_title = "Species tree (nuclear)",
	right_title = "Species tree (plastid)"
)
```

## Nuc tree with node labels
```{r}

library(ape)
library(phytools)

# Read tree
tree <- nuc_tree

# Plot tree
plotTree(
  tree,
  ftype = "i",      # italic tip labels
  fsize = 0.7,
  lwd = 2
)

# Add node support values
nodelabels(
  text = tree$node.label,
  node = (Ntip(tree) + 1):(Ntip(tree) + Nnode(tree)),
  frame = "none",
  cex = 0.6,
  adj = c(-0.2, -0.2),
  col = "red"
)



support <- as.numeric(tree$node.label)

plotTree(tree, ftype = "i")

cols <- ifelse(support >= 95, "darkgreen",
        ifelse(support >= 80, "orange", "red"))

nodelabels(
  pch = 21,
  bg = cols,
  cex = 1.2
)
```

### ggtree


```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

BiocManager::install("ggtree")
```


```{r}
library(ape)
library(ggtree)
library(ggplot2)

# Read tree

# Plot with support values
p <- ggtree(tree) +
  geom_tiplab(size = 3) +
  geom_text2(
    aes(subset = !isTip, label = label),
    hjust = -0.3,
    size = 2.5,
    color = "red"
  ) +
  theme_tree2()

p
```


```{r}

ggtree(tree) +
  geom_tiplab(align = TRUE, linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_label2(
    aes(
      subset = !isTip &
               as.numeric(label) >= 0.95,
      label = round(as.numeric(label), 2)
    ),
    size = 2
  )
```
